lines.en: When will the writer see the play?
lines.zh: 作者什么时候会看这部戏？

lines.en: 'The play may begin at any moment,' I said.
lines.zh: “这出戏随时都可能开始，”我说。

lines.en: 'It may have begun already,' Susan answered.
lines.zh: “可能已经开始了，”苏珊回答说。

lines.en: I hurried to the ticket office.
'May I have two tickets please?' I asked.
'I'm sorry, we've sold out,' the girl said.
lines.zh: “对不起，票已经卖完了，”那个女孩说。

lines.en: Just then, a man hurried to the ticket office.
lines.zh: 就在那时，一个男人匆匆跑到售票处。

lines.en: 'Can I return these two tickets?' he asked.
I went back to the ticket office at once.
'Could I have those two tickets please?' I asked.
'I might as well have them,' I said sadly.
lines.zh: “我还是把它们拿走吧，”我伤心地说。
